expected.subject: dev.product_feedback/accept-refresh-2026-09-07
expected.value: Agent-customer finding: profiling changed the acceptance-to-refresh hypothesis. SDK refresh is a whole-world orientation query, not merely a new-head pointer. Its largest avoidable costs were full fact/provenance views discarded by discovery and repeated provider catalog scans; request-local accepted inputs deliver a meaningful read improvement without persisting another cache. Removing a broad read also removed incidental memo warmup, exposing a per-group Git lookup dependency; measure the full dependent path and test absence of those reads. Acceptance still spends substantial time in Git processes, but complete physical delta reads reduce two broad transfers while retaining payload verification. Report optional orientation separately from the write transaction, because the live SDK and World snapshots already avoid mandatory orientation after acceptance. The next architectural step should be justified by measured remaining phase costs and complete evidence dependencies, not an assumed step change from adding indexes.
